## OPDS Catalog Structure

OPDS feeds follow the Atom syndication format. Here's how FicHub implements them:

```rust
pub async fn catalog_feed(
    State(state): State<Arc<AppState>>,
) -> Result<Response, AppError> {
    let base_url = format!("http://{}:{}", state.config.host, state.config.app_port);

    let xml = format!(r#"<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<feed xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom"
      xmlns:opds="http://opds-spec.org/2010/catalog">

    <title>FicHub Catalog</title>
    <subtitle>Self-hosted fanfiction downloader</subtitle>
    <link href="{}/opds/catalog" rel="self" type="application/atom+xml"/>
    <link href="{}/opds/catalog" rel="start" type="application/atom+xml"/>

    <entry>
        <title>Search</title>
        <link href="{}/opds/search" rel="subsection" type="application/atom+xml"/>
        <id>urn:fichub:search</id>
        <content>Search for fanfiction stories</content>
    </entry>

    <entry>
        <title>Tags</title>
        <link href="{}/opds/tags" rel="subsection" type="application/atom+xml"/>
        <id>urn:fichub:tags</id>
        <content>Browse stories by tag</content>
    </entry>

    <entry>
        <title>Recommendations</title>
        <link href="{}/opds/recommendations" rel="subsection" type="application/atom+xml"/>
        <id>urn:fichub:recommendations</id>
        <content>Get personalized recommendations</content>
    </entry>

</feed>"#, base_url, base_url, base_url, base_url, base_url);

    Ok((
        StatusCode::OK,
        [(axum::http::header::CONTENT_TYPE, "application/atom+xml; charset=utf-8")],
        xml,
    ).into_response())
}
```

## OPDS Search Feed

```rust
pub async fn search_feed(
    State(state): State<Arc<AppState>>,
    Query(params): Query<HashMap<String, String>>,
) -> Result<Response, AppError> {
    let query = params.get("q").unwrap_or(&String::new());
    let base_url = format!("http://{}:{}", state.config.host, state.config.app_port);

    let results = sqlx::query_as::<_, FicInfo>(
        r#"
        SELECT * FROM fic_info
        WHERE to_tsvector('english', title || ' ' || author)
            @@ plainto_tsquery('english', $1)
        ORDER BY updated_at DESC
        LIMIT 50
        "#,
    )
    .bind(query)
    .fetch_all(&state.db)
    .await?;

    let mut entries = String::new();
    for fic in &results {
        let download_url = format!(
            "{}/api/v0/export?url={}",
            base_url,
            urlencoding::encode(&fic.url)
        );

        entries.push_str(&format!(r#"
    <entry>
        <title>{}</title>
        <author><name>{}</name></author>
        <link href="{}" rel="related" type="application/epub+zip"/>
        <link href="{}" rel="alternate" type="text/html"/>
        <id>urn:fichub:{}</id>
        <content type="text">{} words, {} chapters{}</content>
        <opds:price currency="USD">0.00</opds:price>
    </entry>"#,
            escape_xml(&fic.title),
            escape_xml(&fic.author),
            download_url,
            fic.url,
            fic.url_id,
            fic.words,
            fic.chapters,
            if fic.complete { " (Complete)" } else { "" },
        ));
    }

    let xml = format!(r#"<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<feed xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom"
      xmlns:opds="http://opds-spec.org/2010/catalog">
    <title>Search: {}</title>
    <link href="{}/opds/search?q={}" rel="self" type="application/atom+xml"/>
    <link href="{}/opds/catalog" rel="up" type="application/atom+xml"/>
    {}
</feed>"#, escape_xml(query), base_url, urlencoding::encode(query), base_url, entries);

    Ok((
        StatusCode::OK,
        [(axum::http::header::CONTENT_TYPE, "application/atom+xml; charset=utf-8")],
        xml,
    ).into_response())
}

fn escape_xml(s: &str) -> String {
    s.replace('&', "&amp;")
     .replace('<', "&lt;")
     .replace('>', "&gt;")
     .replace('"', "&quot;")
     .replace(''', "&apos;")
}
```

# Chapter: Tags System Deep Dive

## Tag Resolution

```rust
pub async fn resolve_tag(
    pool: &PgPool,
    tag_name: &str,
    tag_type: &str,
) -> Result<i32, sqlx::Error> {
    let normalized_name = normalize_tag_name(tag_name);

    // Step 1: Check if tag exists
    if let Some(tag) = sqlx::query_as::<_, Tag>(
        "SELECT * FROM tags WHERE LOWER(name) = LOWER($1)"
    )
    .bind(&normalized_name)
    .fetch_optional(pool)
    .await?
    {
        return Ok(tag.id);
    }

    // Step 2: Check for alias
    if let Some(alias) = sqlx::query_as::<_, TagAlias>(
        "SELECT ta.* FROM tag_aliases ta WHERE LOWER(ta.alias) = LOWER($1)"
    )
    .bind(&normalized_name)
    .fetch_optional(pool)
    .await?
    {
        return Ok(alias.tag_id);
    }

    // Step 3: Create new tag
    let tag = sqlx::query_as::<_, Tag>(
        r#"
        INSERT INTO tags (name, type)
        VALUES ($1, $2::tag_type)
        RETURNING *
        "#,
    )
    .bind(&normalized_name)
    .bind(tag_type)
    .fetch_one(pool)
    .await?;

    Ok(tag.id)
}

fn normalize_tag_name(name: &str) -> String {
    name.trim()
        .to_lowercase()
        .replace_whitespace(" ")
        .chars()
        .filter(|c| !c.is_control())
        .collect()
}
```

## Tag Voting

```rust
pub async fn record_vote(
    pool: &PgPool,
    fic_url_id: &str,
    tag_id: i32,
    vote: i32,
    voter_ip: &str,
) -> Result<i32, sqlx::Error> {
    sqlx::query(
        r#"
        INSERT INTO fic_tag_votes (fic_url_id, tag_id, vote, voter_ip)
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4::inet)
        ON CONFLICT (fic_url_id, tag_id, voter_ip)
        DO UPDATE SET vote = $3, created_at = NOW()
        "#,
    )
    .bind(fic_url_id)
    .bind(tag_id)
    .bind(vote)
    .bind(voter_ip)
    .execute(pool)
    .await?;

    let new_score: i32 = sqlx::query_scalar(
        "SELECT score FROM tags WHERE id = $1"
    )
    .bind(tag_id)
    .fetch_one(pool)
    .await?
    .unwrap_or(0);

    Ok(new_score)
}
```

## Tag Curator Actions

```rust
pub async fn merge_tags(
    pool: &PgPool,
    source_tag_id: i32,
    target_tag_id: i32,
    curator_token: &str,
) -> Result<(), AppError> {
    verify_curator_token(pool, curator_token).await?;

    let mut tx = pool.begin().await?;

    // Move fic_tag associations
    sqlx::query(
        r#"
        INSERT INTO fic_tags (fic_url_id, tag_id, submitted_by, created_at)
        SELECT fic_url_id, $2, submitted_by, created_at
        FROM fic_tags WHERE tag_id = $1
        ON CONFLICT (fic_url_id, tag_id) DO NOTHING
        "#,
    )
    .bind(source_tag_id)
    .bind(target_tag_id)
    .execute(&mut *tx)
    .await?;

    // Move votes
    sqlx::query(
        r#"
        INSERT INTO fic_tag_votes (fic_url_id, tag_id, vote, voter_ip, created_at)
        SELECT fic_url_id, $2, vote, voter_ip, created_at
        FROM fic_tag_votes WHERE tag_id = $1
        ON CONFLICT (fic_url_id, tag_id, voter_ip) DO UPDATE SET vote = EXCLUDED.vote
        "#,
    )
    .bind(source_tag_id)
    .bind(target_tag_id)
    .execute(&mut *tx)
    .await?;

    // Move aliases
    sqlx::query("UPDATE tag_aliases SET tag_id = $2 WHERE tag_id = $1")
        .bind(source_tag_id)
        .bind(target_tag_id)
        .execute(&mut *tx)
        .await?;

    // Delete source tag
    sqlx::query("DELETE FROM tags WHERE id = $1")
        .bind(source_tag_id)
        .execute(&mut *tx)
        .await?;

    tx.commit().await?;
    Ok(())
}
```

# Chapter: Cross-Cutting Concerns Deep Dive

## Health Checks

```rust
pub async fn health_check(
    State(state): State<Arc<AppState>>,
) -> Json<Value> {
    let mut checks = HashMap::new();

    // Database check
    let db_ok = sqlx::query("SELECT 1")
        .execute(&state.db)
        .await
        .is_ok();
    checks.insert("database", db_ok);

    // Redis check
    let redis_ok = redis::cmd("PING")
        .query_async::<String>(&mut state.redis.clone())
        .await
        .is_ok();
    checks.insert("redis", redis_ok);

    // Disk cache check
    let cache_ok = std::fs::metadata(&state.config.cache_dir).is_ok();
    checks.insert("cache", cache_ok);

    let all_healthy = checks.values().all(|&v| v);

    Json(json!({
        "status": if all_healthy { "healthy" } else { "degraded" },
        "checks": checks,
        "version": env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION"),
    }))
}
```

## Graceful Shutdown

```rust
use tokio::signal;

pub async fn run_server(config: Config) {
    let app = build_router(state).await;
    let listener = TcpListener::bind(format!("0.0.0.0:{}", config.app_port))
        .await
        .unwrap();

    tracing::info!("Server starting on port {}", config.app_port);

    let server = axum::serve(listener, app)
        .with_graceful_shutdown(shutdown_signal());

    server.await.expect("Server error");
}

async fn shutdown_signal() {
    let ctrl_c = async {
        signal::ctrl_c()
            .await
            .expect("failed to install Ctrl+C handler");
    };

    #[cfg(unix)]
    let terminate = async {
        signal::unix::signal(signal::unix::SignalKind::terminate())
            .expect("failed to install signal handler")
            .recv()
            .await;
    };

    tokio::select! {
        _ = ctrl_c => {
            tracing::info!("Ctrl+C received, starting graceful shutdown");
        }
        _ = terminate => {
            tracing::info!("SIGTERM received, starting graceful shutdown");
        }
    }

    // Give in-flight requests time to complete
    tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_secs(5)).await;
    tracing::info!("Server shut down gracefully");
}
```

# Chapter: Axum Router Deep Dive

## Route Groups and Nesting

FicHub uses route groups to organize endpoints:

```rust
pub async fn build_router(state: Arc<AppState>) -> Router {
    // API routes
    let api_routes = Router::new()
        .route("/export", get(routes::export::export_handler))
        .route("/meta", get(routes::meta::meta_handler))
        .route("/remote", get(routes::meta::remote_handler))
        .route("/search", get(routes::search::search_handler))
        .route("/tags", get(routes::tags::list_tags))
        .route("/tags/submit", post(routes::tags::submit_tag))
        .route("/tags/vote", post(routes::tags::vote_tag))
        .route("/tags/flag", post(routes::tags::flag_tag))
        .route("/recommendations/{source}", get(routes::recommender::get_recommendations))
        .route("/suggestions", get(routes::recommender::list_suggestions))
        .route("/suggestions/submit", post(routes::recommender::submit_suggestion))
        .route("/suggestions/vote", post(routes::recommender::cast_vote));

    // OPDS routes
    let opds_routes = routes::opds::opds_router();

    // Static file serving
    let frontend_dir = state.config.frontend_dir.clone();
    let static_files = ServeDir::new(&frontend_dir)
        .not_found_service(ServeFile::new(frontend_dir.join("index.html")));

    Router::new()
        .nest("/api/v0", api_routes)
        .nest("/opds", opds_routes)
        .route_service("/assets/*path", ServeDir::new(frontend_dir.join("assets"))
            .precompressed_gzip()
            .precompressed_br())
        .route("/cache/*path", get(routes::cache_download::download_handler))
        .fallback_service(static_files)
        .layer(TraceLayer::new_for_http())
        .layer(CorsLayer::new()
            .allow_origin(Any)
            .allow_methods(Any)
            .allow_headers(Any))
        .with_state(state)
}
```

### Rate Limiting Middleware

```rust
async fn rate_limit_middleware(
    State(state): State<Arc<AppState>>,
    request: Request,
    next: Next,
) -> Result<Response, AppError> {
    let ip = request.headers()
        .get("X-Forwarded-For")
        .and_then(|v| v.to_str().ok())
        .unwrap_or("unknown");

    match state.rate_limiter.check(ip).await? {
        RateLimitResult::Allowed => Ok(next.run(request).await),
        RateLimitResult::Limited { retry_after } => {
            Err(AppError::RateLimited(retry_after))
        }
    }
}
```

### Authentication Middleware

```rust
async fn auth_middleware(
    State(state): State<Arc<AppState>>,
    request: Request,
    next: Next,
) -> Result<Response, AppError> {
    // Skip auth for public endpoints
    let path = request.uri().path();
    if path.starts_with("/api/v0/search")
        || path.starts_with("/api/v0/tags")
        || path.starts_with("/opds/")
    {
        return Ok(next.run(request).await);
    }

    let api_key = request.headers()
        .get("X-API-Key")
        .and_then(|v| v.to_str().ok());

    match api_key {
        Some(key) if key == &state.config.api_key => {
            Ok(next.run(request).await)
        }
        _ => Err(AppError::Unauthorized("invalid API key".into())),
    }
}
```

```rust
async fn custom_error_handler() -> Result<Response, AppError> {
    let result = do_something().await;

    match result {
        Ok(data) => Ok(Json(json!({"data": data})).into_response()),
        Err(AppError::NotFound(msg)) => {
            Ok((StatusCode::NOT_FOUND, Json(json!({"error": msg}))).into_response())
```

```rust
async fn handler(
    Path(id): Path<i32>,
    Query(params): Query<HashMap<String, String>>,
    State(state): State<Arc<AppState>>,
) -> Result<Json<Value>, AppError> {
    // Path extraction fails → 400 Bad Request (automatic)
    // Query extraction fails → 400 Bad Request (automatic)

    if id <= 0 {
        return Err(AppError::BadRequest(-1, "ID must be positive".into()));
    }

    let data = fetch_data(&state.db, id).await?;
    Ok(Json(json!({"data": data})))
}
```

# Chapter: Advanced SQL Patterns

## Window Functions

Window functions perform calculations across rows related to the current row:

```sql
-- Rank stories by word count within each source
SELECT
    url_id,
    title,
    author,
    words,
    source,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY source ORDER BY words DESC) as rank_in_source,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY words DESC) as overall_rank,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY words DESC) as percentile
FROM fic_info
WHERE complete = true
ORDER BY overall_rank
LIMIT 20;

-- Running total of exports per day
SELECT
    DATE(created_at) as export_date,
    COUNT(*) as daily_exports,
    SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY DATE(created_at)) as cumulative_exports
FROM export_log
WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
GROUP BY DATE(created_at)
ORDER BY export_date;

-- Find the most popular tags per source
WITH tag_stats AS (
    SELECT
        f.source,
        t.name as tag_name,
        COUNT(*) as usage_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.source ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) as rank
    FROM fic_info f
    JOIN fic_tags ft ON f.url_id = ft.fic_url_id
    JOIN tags t ON ft.tag_id = t.id
    GROUP BY f.source, t.name
)
SELECT * FROM tag_stats WHERE rank <= 10;
```

## Common Table Expressions (CTEs)

```sql
-- Find stories that are popular but have few tags
WITH popular_stories AS (
    SELECT
        f.url_id,
        f.title,
        f.author,
        COUNT(e.id) as download_count
    FROM fic_info f
    JOIN export_log e ON f.url_id = e.url_id
    GROUP BY f.url_id, f.title, f.author
    HAVING COUNT(e.id) > 10
),
tag_counts AS (
    SELECT
        ft.fic_url_id,
        COUNT(ft.tag_id) as tag_count
    FROM fic_tags ft
    GROUP BY ft.fic_url_id
)
SELECT
    ps.title,
    ps.author,
    ps.download_count,
    COALESCE(tc.tag_count, 0) as tag_count
FROM popular_stories ps
LEFT JOIN tag_counts tc ON ps.url_id = tc.fic_url_id
WHERE COALESCE(tc.tag_count, 0) < 3
ORDER BY ps.download_count DESC;

-- Recursive CTE for tag hierarchies
WITH RECURSIVE tag_tree AS (
    SELECT id, name, canonical_id, 0 as depth
    FROM tags
    WHERE canonical_id IS NULL

    UNION ALL

    SELECT t.id, t.name, t.canonical_id, tt.depth + 1
    FROM tags t
    JOIN tag_tree tt ON t.canonical_id = tt.id
    WHERE tt.depth < 5
)
SELECT * FROM tag_tree ORDER BY depth, name;
```

## Connection Pool Monitoring

```rust
pub async fn monitor_pool(pool: &PgPool) -> Result<(), sqlx::Error> {
    let stats = pool.options().get_stats();

    tracing::info!(
        active = stats.active_connections,
        idle = stats.idle_connections,
        max = stats.max_connections,
        "Pool statistics"
    );

    if stats.active_connections > stats.max_connections * 80 / 100 {
        tracing::warn!(
            active = stats.active_connections,
            max = stats.max_connections,
            "Connection pool usage above 80%"
        );
    }

    let long_queries = sqlx::query_as::<_, (i32, String, chrono::Duration)>(
        r#"
        SELECT pid, query, now() - query_start as duration
        FROM pg_stat_activity
        WHERE state = 'active'
        AND query_start < now() - INTERVAL '30 seconds'
        ORDER BY duration DESC
        "#,
    )
    .fetch_all(pool)
    .await?;

    for (pid, query, duration) in long_queries {
        tracing::warn!(
            pid = pid,
            duration_secs = duration.num_seconds(),
            query = %query,
            "Long-running query detected"
        );
    }

    Ok(())
}
```

## Batch Operations

```rust
pub async fn batch_upsert(
    pool: &PgPool,
    records: &[NewRecord],
) -> Result<u64, sqlx::Error> {
    let mut total_affected = 0u64;

    for chunk in records.chunks(1000) {
        let affected = sqlx::query(
            r#"
            INSERT INTO records (name, value, created_at)
            SELECT * FROM UNNEST($1::text[], $2::int[], $3::timestamptz[])
            ON CONFLICT (name) DO UPDATE SET
                value = EXCLUDED.value,
                updated_at = NOW()
            "#,
        )
        .bind(chunk.iter().map(|r| &r.name).collect::<Vec<_>>())
        .bind(chunk.iter().map(|r| r.value).collect::<Vec<_>>())
        .bind(chunk.iter().map(|r| r.created_at).collect::<Vec<_>>())
        .execute(pool)
        .await?
        .rows_affected();

        total_affected += affected;
    }

    Ok(total_affected)
}
```

# Chapter: Recommendation Engine Deep Dive

## Collaborative Filtering Mathematics

### Jaccard Coefficient Explained

The Jaccard coefficient measures similarity between two sets. For FicHub, we use it to measure how similar two stories are based on their readers.

Given two stories A and B:
- Let `U(A)` be the set of users who downloaded story A
- Let `U(B)` be the set of users who downloaded story B

The Jaccard coefficient is:

```
J(A, B) = |U(A) ∩ U(B)| / |U(A) ∪ U(B)|
```

**Example:**
```
Story "Methods of Rationality" downloaded by: {Alice, Bob, Carol, Dave, Eve}
Story "Natural 20" downloaded by: {Alice, Bob, Frank, Grace, Henry}

Intersection: {Alice, Bob} → size 2
Union: {Alice, Bob, Carol, Dave, Eve, Frank, Grace, Henry} → size 8

Jaccard = 2 / 8 = 0.25
```

### Implementing Jaccard in Rust

```rust
pub struct JaccardCalculator;

impl JaccardCalculator {
    pub fn compute(set_a: &HashSet<String>, set_b: &HashSet<String>) -> f64 {
        if set_a.is_empty() && set_b.is_empty() {
            return 0.0;
        }

        let intersection = set_a.intersection(set_b).count();
        let union = set_a.union(set_b).count();

        intersection as f64 / union as f64
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn test_jaccard_identical_sets() {
        let a: HashSet<String> = vec!["a", "b", "c"].into_iter().map(String::from).collect();
        let b = a.clone();
        assert_eq!(JaccardCalculator::compute(&a, &b), 1.0);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_jaccard_disjoint_sets() {
        let a: HashSet<String> = vec!["a", "b"].into_iter().map(String::from).collect();
        let b: HashSet<String> = vec!["c", "d"].into_iter().map(String::from).collect();
        assert_eq!(JaccardCalculator::compute(&a, &b), 0.0);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_jaccard_partial_overlap() {
        let a: HashSet<String> = vec!["a", "b", "c"].into_iter().map(String::from).collect();
        let b: HashSet<String> = vec!["b", "c", "d"].into_iter().map(String::from).collect();
        assert!((JaccardCalculator::compute(&a, &b) - 0.5).abs() < 0.001);
    }
}
```

### Co-occurrence Matrix

FicHub maintains a co-occurrence matrix that tracks which stories are downloaded together:

```sql
CREATE TABLE fic_bookmark_cooccur (
    fic_a TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES fic_info(url_id),
    fic_b TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES fic_info(url_id),
    score INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
    PRIMARY KEY (fic_a, fic_b),
    CHECK (fic_a < fic_b)
);
```

### Computing Recommendations

```rust
impl RecommendationEngine {
    pub async fn compute_recommendations(
        &self,
        url_id: &str,
        limit: usize,
    ) -> Result<Vec<Recommendation>, AppError> {
        // Get co-occurring stories
        let cooccurring = sqlx::query_as::<_, (String, i32)>(
            r#"
            SELECT fic_b, score FROM fic_bookmark_cooccur WHERE fic_a = $1
            UNION ALL
            SELECT fic_a, score FROM fic_bookmark_cooccur WHERE fic_b = $1
            ORDER BY score DESC
            LIMIT 100
            "#,
        )
        .bind(url_id)
        .fetch_all(&self.db)
        .await?;

        let mut recommendations = Vec::new();
        for (rec_url_id, cooccurrence_score) in cooccurring {
            if let Some(meta) = self.get_fic_metadata(&rec_url_id).await? {
                let jaccard = cooccurrence_score as f64 / 100.0;
                let voting_boost = self.get_voting_boost(&rec_url_id).await?;
                let combined = jaccard + self.config.rec_voting_boost_gamma * voting_boost;

                recommendations.push(Recommendation {
                    url_id: rec_url_id,
                    title: meta.title,
                    author: meta.author,
                    words: meta.words,
                    chapters: meta.chapters,
                    complete: meta.complete,
                    score: combined,
                });
            }
        }

        recommendations.sort_by(|a, b| b.score.partial_cmp(&a.score).unwrap());
        recommendations.truncate(limit);

        Ok(recommendations)
    }

    async fn get_voting_boost(&self, url_id: &str) -> Result<f64, sqlx::Error> {
        let votes: i64 = sqlx::query_scalar(
            "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(vote), 0) FROM recommendation_votes WHERE url_id = $1"
        )
        .bind(url_id)
        .fetch_one(&self.db)
        .await?
        .unwrap_or(0);

        Ok((1.0 + votes as f64).ln())
    }
}
```

## Tag-Based Fallback

```rust
pub async fn tag_based_recommendations(
    &self,
    url_id: &str,
    limit: usize,
) -> Result<Vec<Recommendation>, AppError> {
    let tags = sqlx::query_scalar::<_, serde_json::Value>(
        "SELECT tags FROM fic_info WHERE url_id = $1"
    )
    .bind(url_id)
    .fetch_optional(&self.db)
    .await?
    .unwrap_or(serde_json::json!([]));

    let results = sqlx::query_as::<_, FicInfo>(
        r#"
        SELECT f.*
        FROM fic_info f
        WHERE f.url_id != $1
          AND f.tags @> $2::jsonb
        ORDER BY f.words DESC
        LIMIT $3
        "#,
    )
    .bind(url_id)
    .bind(&tags)
    .bind(limit as i64)
    .fetch_all(&self.db)
    .await?;

    Ok(results.into_iter().map(|fic| Recommendation {
        url_id: fic.url_id,
        title: fic.title,
        author: fic.author,
        words: fic.words,
        chapters: fic.chapters,
        complete: fic.complete,
        score: 0.5,
    }).collect())
}
```

## Suggestion System

```rust
pub async fn submit_suggestion(
    State(state): State<Arc<AppState>>,
    Json(input): Json<SubmitSuggestion>,
) -> Result<Json<Value>, AppError> {
    let url_id = generate_url_id(&input.url)
        .ok_or_else(|| AppError::BadRequest(-5, "unsupported URL".into()))?;

    let exists: bool = sqlx::query_scalar(
        "SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM recommendation_suggestions WHERE url_id = $1)"
    )
    .bind(&url_id)
    .fetch_one(&state.db)
    .await?
    .unwrap_or(false);

    if exists {
        return Err(AppError::BadRequest(-2, "already suggested".into()));
    }

    let ip = input.voter_ip.as_deref().unwrap_or("unknown");
    let recent_count: i64 = sqlx::query_scalar(
        r#"
        SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recommendation_suggestions
        WHERE voter_ip = $1::inet
        AND created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'
        "#,
    )
    .bind(ip)
    .fetch_one(&state.db)
    .await?
    .unwrap_or(0);

    if recent_count >= state.config.rec_suggest_limit_per_hour as i64 {
        return Err(AppError::RateLimited(3600));
    }

    sqlx::query(
        r#"
        INSERT INTO recommendation_suggestions (url_id, suggested_by, voter_ip)
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3::inet)
        "#,
    )
    .bind(&url_id)
    .bind(&input.suggested_by)
    .bind(ip)
    .execute(&state.db)
    .await?;

    Ok(Json(json!({"err": 0, "msg": "suggestion submitted"})))
}
```

## Voting System

```rust
pub async fn cast_vote(
    State(state): State<Arc<AppState>>,
    Json(input): Json<CastVote>,
) -> Result<Json<Value>, AppError> {
    let vote_value: i32 = if input.vote { 1 } else { -1 };
    let ip = input.voter_ip.as_deref().unwrap_or("unknown");

    sqlx::query(
        r#"
        INSERT INTO recommendation_votes (url_id, voter_ip, vote)
        VALUES ($1, $2::inet, $3)
        ON CONFLICT (url_id, voter_ip)
        DO UPDATE SET vote = $3, updated_at = NOW()
        "#,
    )
    .bind(&input.url_id)
    .bind(ip)
    .bind(vote_value)
    .execute(&state.db)
    .await?;

    let total_score: i64 = sqlx::query_scalar(
        "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(vote), 0) FROM recommendation_votes WHERE url_id = $1"
    )
    .bind(&input.url_id)
    .fetch_one(&state.db)
    .await?
    .unwrap_or(0);

    Ok(Json(json!({
        "err": 0,
        "score": total_score,
        "vote": vote_value,
    })))
}
```

## Collection Worker

```rust
impl CollectionWorker {
    pub async fn run(&self) {
        loop {
            match self.process_next().await {
                Ok(true) => {}
                Ok(false) => {
                    tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_secs(
                        self.config.rec_default_delay_secs
                    )).await;
                }
                Err(e) => {
                    tracing::error!("Worker error: {}", e);
                    tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_secs(5)).await;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    async fn process_next(&self) -> Result<bool, AppError> {
        let url: Option<String> = redis::Cmd::new()
            .arg("LPOP")
            .arg("rec:collect:queue")
            .query_async(&mut self.redis.clone())
            .await?;

        let url = match url {
            Some(url) => url,
            None => return Ok(false),
        };

        let scraper = self.scraper_registry.find_scraper(&url)
            .ok_or_else(|| AppError::ScrapeError("unsupported URL".into()))?;

        let metadata = scraper.lookup(&self.http_client, &url).await?;
        self.update_cooccurrence(&metadata.url_id).await?;

        if self.config.rec_precompute_enabled {
            self.maybe_precompute(&metadata.url_id).await?;
        }

        Ok(true)
    }

    async fn update_cooccurrence(&self, url_id: &str) -> Result<(), AppError> {
        sqlx::query(
            r#"
            WITH recent_downloads AS (
                SELECT DISTINCT url_id
                FROM export_log
                WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
            )
            INSERT INTO fic_bookmark_cooccur (fic_a, fic_b, score)
            SELECT
                LEAST($1, rd.url_id),
                GREATEST($1, rd.url_id),
                1
            FROM recent_downloads rd
            WHERE rd.url_id != $1
            ON CONFLICT (fic_a, fic_b) DO UPDATE SET
                score = fic_bookmark_cooccur.score + 1,
                updated_at = NOW()
            "#,
        )
        .bind(url_id)
        .execute(&self.db)
        .await?;

        Ok(())
    }
}
```

## Environment-Based Configuration

FicHub uses environment variables for configuration. Here's a comprehensive guide:

### Required Variables

```bash
# Database connection
DATABASE_URL=postgres://fichub:password@localhost/fichub

# Redis connection
REDIS_URL=redis://127.0.0.1/

# Cache directory
CACHE_DIR=/var/lib/fichub/cache
```

### Optional Variables with Defaults

```bash
# Server
PORT=3000
NODE_NAME=orion

# Feature flags
DYNAMIC_RATE_LIMIT=true
EXPORT_VERSION=1

# Paths
TMP_DIR=/tmp/fichub
FRONTEND_DIR=./frontend/build

# Calibre (for EPUB conversion)
CALIBRE_CONTAINER=

# Recommender
REC_DEFAULT_DELAY_SECS=60

REC_CACHE_TTL_HOURS=24
REC_PRECOMPUTE_ENABLED=false

# Tags
CURATOR_TOKEN=

# Search

# OPDS
```

### Configuration Validation

```rust
impl Config {
    pub fn from_env() -> Self {
        let database_url = std::env::var("DATABASE_URL")
            .expect("DATABASE_URL must be set");

        // Validate database URL
        if !database_url.starts_with("postgres://") && !database_url.starts_with("postgresql://") {
            panic!("DATABASE_URL must start with postgres:// or postgresql://");
        }

        let redis_url = std::env::var("REDIS_URL")
            .expect("REDIS_URL must be set");

        let cache_dir = std::env::var("CACHE_DIR")
            .unwrap_or_else(|_| "./cache".to_string());

        // Validate cache directory is writable
        let cache_path = PathBuf::from(&cache_dir);
        if !cache_path.exists() {
            std::fs::create_dir_all(&cache_path)
                .expect("Failed to create CACHE_DIR");
        }

        let app_port = std::env::var("PORT")
            .unwrap_or_else(|_| "3000".to_string())
            .parse()
            .expect("PORT must be a valid port number");

        if app_port == 0 {
            panic!("PORT cannot be 0");
        }

        // Parse recommender settings
        let rec_default_delay_secs = std::env::var("REC_DEFAULT_DELAY_SECS")
            .unwrap_or_else(|_| "60".to_string())
            .parse()
            .unwrap_or(60);

        let rec_max_recommendations = std::env::var("REC_MAX_RECOMMENDATIONS")
            .unwrap_or_else(|_| "20".to_string())
            .parse()
            .unwrap_or(20);

        Self {
            database_url,
            redis_url,
            cache_dir: cache_path,
            secondary_cache_dir: std::env::var("SECONDARY_CACHE_DIR")
                .ok()
                .filter(|s| !s.is_empty())
                .map(PathBuf::from),
            export_version: std::env::var("EXPORT_VERSION")
                .unwrap_or_else(|_| "1".to_string())
                .parse()
                .unwrap_or(1),
            dynamic_rate_limit: std::env::var("DYNAMIC_RATE_LIMIT")
                .unwrap_or_else(|_| "true".to_string())
                .parse()
                .unwrap_or(true),
            node_name: std::env::var("NODE_NAME")
                .unwrap_or_else(|_| "orion".to_string()),
            calibre_container: std::env::var("CALIBRE_CONTAINER")
                .unwrap_or_default(),
            tmp_dir: PathBuf::from(std::env::var("TMP_DIR")
                .unwrap_or_else(|_| "./tmp".to_string())),
            app_port,
            frontend_dir: PathBuf::from(std::env::var("FRONTEND_DIR")
                .unwrap_or_else(|_| "./frontend/build".to_string())),
            trusted_proxies: std::env::var("TRUSTED_PROXIES")
                .unwrap_or_else(|_| "127.0.0.1,::1".to_string())
                .split(',')
                .map(|s| s.trim().to_string())
                .collect(),
            ip_tag_sources: parse_ip_tag_sources(),
            rec_default_delay_secs,
            rec_site_rate_limits: parse_site_rate_limits(),
            rec_max_favourite_pages: env_or("REC_MAX_FAVOURITE_PAGES", 10),
            rec_max_user_favourite_pages: env_or("REC_MAX_USER_FAVOURITE_PAGES", 5),
            rec_max_recommendations,
            rec_min_favouriters_for_collab: env_or("REC_MIN_FAVOURITERS_FOR_COLLAB", 3),
            rec_voting_boost_gamma: env_or_f64("REC_VOTING_BOOST_GAMMA", 0.5),
            rec_cache_ttl_hours: env_or("REC_CACHE_TTL_HOURS", 24),
            rec_suggest_limit_per_hour: env_or("REC_SUGGEST_LIMIT_PER_HOUR", 5),
            rec_vote_limit_per_hour: env_or("REC_VOTE_LIMIT_PER_HOUR", 30),
            rec_precompute_enabled: env_or_bool("REC_PRECOMPUTE_ENABLED", false),
            rec_precompute_interval_hours: env_or("REC_PRECOMPUTE_INTERVAL_HOURS", 24),
            rec_enable_cross_site: env_or_bool("REC_ENABLE_CROSS_SITE", true),
            curator_token: std::env::var("CURATOR_TOKEN").ok()
                .filter(|s| !s.is_empty()),
            tag_hidden_threshold: env_or_i16("TAG_HIDDEN_THRESHOLD", -5),
            tag_auto_delete_threshold: std::env::var("TAG_AUTO_DELETE_THRESHOLD")
                .ok()
                .and_then(|s| s.parse().ok()),
            tag_submit_limit_per_hour: env_or("TAG_SUBMIT_LIMIT_PER_HOUR", 10),
            tag_vote_limit_per_hour: env_or("TAG_VOTE_LIMIT_PER_HOUR", 30),
            search_max_per_page: env_or("SEARCH_MAX_PER_PAGE", 50),
            opds_shelf_token: std::env::var("OPDS_SHELF_TOKEN")
                .unwrap_or_else(|_| uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string()),
        }
    }

            rec_enable_cross_site: true,
            curator_token: None,
            tag_hidden_threshold: -5,
            tag_auto_delete_threshold: None,
            tag_submit_limit_per_hour: 10,
            tag_vote_limit_per_hour: 30,
            search_max_per_page: 50,
            opds_shelf_token: "test-token".into(),
        }
    }
}

fn env_or(name: &str, default: u32) -> u32 {
    std::env::var(name)
        .ok()
        .and_then(|s| s.parse().ok())
        .unwrap_or(default)
}

fn env_or_f64(name: &str, default: f64) -> f64 {
    std::env::var(name)
        .ok()
        .and_then(|s| s.parse().ok())
        .unwrap_or(default)
}

fn env_or_bool(name: &str, default: bool) -> bool {
    std::env::var(name)
        .ok()
        .and_then(|s| s.parse().ok())
        .unwrap_or(default)
}

fn env_or_i16(name: &str, default: i16) -> i16 {
    std::env::var(name)
        .ok()
        .and_then(|s| s.parse().ok())
        .unwrap_or(default)
}
```

# Chapter: Error Handling Patterns

## Error Types in FicHub

```rust
#[derive(Debug)]
pub enum AppError {
    BadRequest(i32, String),
    RateLimited(u64),
    NotFound(String),
    Internal(String),
    ScrapeError(String),
    ExportError(String),
    Database(String),
    CacheError(String),
}

impl std::fmt::Display for AppError {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
        match self {
            AppError::BadRequest(code, msg) => write!(f, "BadRequest({}): {}", code, msg),
            AppError::RateLimited(retry_after) => write!(f, "RateLimited: retry after {}s", retry_after),
            AppError::NotFound(msg) => write!(f, "NotFound: {}", msg),
            AppError::Internal(msg) => write!(f, "Internal: {}", msg),
            AppError::ScrapeError(msg) => write!(f, "ScrapeError: {}", msg),
            AppError::ExportError(msg) => write!(f, "ExportError: {}", msg),
            AppError::Database(msg) => write!(f, "Database: {}", msg),
            AppError::CacheError(msg) => write!(f, "CacheError: {}", msg),
        }
    }
}

impl IntoResponse for AppError {
    fn into_response(self) -> Response {
        let (status, body) = match self {
            AppError::BadRequest(code, msg) => (
                StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST,
                json!({"err": code, "msg": msg}),
            ),
            AppError::RateLimited(retry_after) => (
                StatusCode::TOO_MANY_REQUESTS,
                json!({"err": -429, "msg": "rate limited", "retry_after": retry_after}),
            ),
            AppError::NotFound(msg) => (
                StatusCode::NOT_FOUND,
                json!({"err": -5, "msg": msg}),
            ),
            AppError::Internal(msg) => {
                tracing::error!("Internal error: {}", msg);
                (
                    StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
                    json!({"err": -1, "msg": "internal server error"}),
                )
            }
            AppError::ScrapeError(msg) => (
                StatusCode::BAD_GATEWAY,
                json!({"err": -6, "msg": msg}),
            ),
            AppError::ExportError(msg) => {
                tracing::error!("Export error: {}", msg);
                (
                    StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
                    json!({"err": -5, "msg": "export failed"}),
                )
            }
            AppError::Database(msg) => {
                tracing::error!("Database error: {}", msg);
                (
                    StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
                    json!({"err": -1, "msg": "database error"}),
                )
            }
            AppError::CacheError(msg) => {
                tracing::error!("Cache error: {}", msg);
                (
                    StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
                    json!({"err": -1, "msg": "cache error"}),
                )
            }
        };

        (status, Json(body)).into_response()
    }
}

// From implementations for automatic error conversion
impl From<sqlx::Error> for AppError {
    fn from(err: sqlx::Error) -> Self {
        match err {
            sqlx::Error::RowNotFound => {
                AppError::NotFound("resource not found".into())
            }
            sqlx::Error::Database(ref db_err) => {
                if db_err.code() == Some("23505".into()) {
                    AppError::BadRequest(-2, "already exists".into())
                } else {
                    AppError::Database(db_err.message().unwrap_or("unknown").into())
                }
            }
            _ => AppError::Database(err.to_string()),
        }
    }
}

impl From<redis::RedisError> for AppError {
    fn from(err: redis::RedisError) -> Self {
        AppError::CacheError(err.to_string())
    }
}

impl From<reqwest::Error> for AppError {
    fn from(err: reqwest::Error) -> Self {
        if err.is_timeout() {
            AppError::ScrapeError("request timed out".into())
        } else if err.is_connect() {
            AppError::ScrapeError("connection failed".into())
        } else {
            AppError::ScrapeError(err.to_string())
        }
    }
}
```

## Error Recovery Strategies

```rust
pub async fn resilient_export(
    url: &str,
    state: &Arc<AppState>,
) -> Result<PathBuf, AppError> {
    let max_retries = 3;

    for attempt in 0..max_retries {
        match export_story(url, state).await {
            Ok(path) => return Ok(path),
            Err(AppError::ScrapeError(msg)) if msg.contains("timeout") && attempt < max_retries - 1 => {
                tracing::warn!(url = url, attempt = attempt + 1, "Export timed out, retrying");
                tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_secs(2u64.pow(attempt as u32))).await;
                continue;
            }
            Err(AppError::ScrapeError(msg)) if msg.contains("rate limited") && attempt < max_retries - 1 => {
                tracing::warn!(url = url, attempt = attempt + 1, "Rate limited, retrying after delay");
                tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_secs(30)).await;
                continue;
            }
            Err(e) => return Err(e),
        }
    }

    Err(AppError::Internal("max retries exceeded".into()))
}
```

## HTML Parsing Deep Dive

### Understanding the Scraper Crate

The `scraper` crate provides jQuery-like HTML parsing. Here's how to use it effectively:

```rust
use scraper::{Html, Selector};

fn parse_story_metadata(html: &str) -> Result<StoryMetadata, ScrapeError> {
    let document = Html::parse_document(html);

    // Parse title
    let title_selector = Selector::parse("h1.title")
        .map_err(|e| ScrapeError::Parse(e.to_string()))?;
    let title = document
        .select(&title_selector)
        .next()
        .map(|el| el.text().collect::<String>().trim().to_string())
        .unwrap_or_default();

    // Parse author
    let author_selector = Selector::parse("a.author")
        .map_err(|e| ScrapeError::Parse(e.to_string()))?;
    let author = document
        .select(&author_selector)
        .next()
        .map(|el| el.text().collect::<String>().trim().to_string())
        .unwrap_or_default();

    // Parse word count from metadata section
    let stats_selector = Selector::parse("span.stats .words")
        .map_err(|e| ScrapeError::Parse(e.to_string()))?;
    let words = document
        .select(&stats_selector)
        .next()
        .and_then(|el| el.text().next())
        .and_then(|t| t.trim().replace(',', "").parse::<i32>().ok())
        .unwrap_or(0);

    // Parse tags
    let tag_selector = Selector::parse("ul.tags li a")
        .map_err(|e| ScrapeError::Parse(e.to_string()))?;
    let tags: Vec<String> = document
        .select(&tag_selector)
        .map(|el| el.text().collect::<String>().trim().to_string())
        .filter(|t| !t.is_empty())
        .collect();

    // Parse chapter content
    let content_selector = Selector::parse("div.chapter-content")
        .map_err(|e| ScrapeError::Parse(e.to_string()))?;
    let content = document
        .select(&content_selector)
        .next()
        .map(|el| el.inner_html())
        .unwrap_or_default();

    // Parse completion status
    let status_selector = Selector::parse("span.status")
        .map_err(|e| ScrapeError::Parse(e.to_string()))?;
    let complete = document
        .select(&status_selector)
        .next()
        .and_then(|el| el.text().next())
        .map(|t| t.trim().to_lowercase() == "complete")
        .unwrap_or(false);

    Ok(StoryMetadata {
        title,
        author,
        words,
        tags,
        content,
        complete,
    })
}
```

## Rate Limiting per Site

Different sites have different rate limits. FicHub implements per-site rate limiting:

```rust
pub struct SiteRateLimiter {
    limits: HashMap<String, RateLimitConfig>,
    state: HashMap<String, RateLimitState>,
}

struct RateLimitConfig {
    requests_per_second: f64,
    burst_size: u32,
}

struct RateLimitState {
    tokens: f64,
    last_refill: Instant,
}

impl SiteRateLimiter {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        let mut limits = HashMap::new();

        limits.insert("ao3".to_string(), RateLimitConfig {
            requests_per_second: 1.0,
            burst_size: 3,
        });

        limits.insert("ffnet".to_string(), RateLimitConfig {
            requests_per_second: 2.0,
            burst_size: 5,
        });

        limits.insert("xenforo".to_string(), RateLimitConfig {
            requests_per_second: 0.5,
            burst_size: 2,
        });

        Self { limits, state: HashMap::new() }
    }

    pub async fn wait_for_slot(&mut self, site: &str) {
        let config = self.limits.get(site).cloned().unwrap_or(RateLimitConfig {
            requests_per_second: 1.0,
            burst_size: 1,
        });

        let state = self.state.entry(site.to_string()).or_insert(RateLimitState {
            tokens: config.burst_size as f64,
            last_refill: Instant::now(),
        });

        let elapsed = state.last_refill.elapsed().as_secs_f64();
        state.tokens = (state.tokens + elapsed * config.requests_per_second)
            .min(config.burst_size as f64);
        state.last_refill = Instant::now();

        if state.tokens < 1.0 {
            let wait_time = (1.0 - state.tokens) / config.requests_per_second;
            tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_secs_f64(wait_time)).await;
            state.tokens = 1.0;
        }

        state.tokens -= 1.0;
    }
}
```

## Error Recovery in Scrapers

```rust
pub async fn resilient_scrape(
    client: &Client,
    url: &str,
    max_retries: u32,
) -> Result<String, ScrapeError> {
    let mut last_error = None;

    for attempt in 0..max_retries {
        match client.get(url).send().await {
            Ok(response) => {
                if response.status().is_success() {
                    return response.text().await.map_err(Into::into);
                }

                if response.status().is_client_error() {
                    return Err(ScrapeError::Http(reqwest::Error::from(response)));
                }

                last_error = Some(ScrapeError::Parse(format!("HTTP {}", response.status())));
            }
            Err(e) => {
                if e.is_timeout() || e.is_connect() {
                    last_error = Some(ScrapeError::Http(e));
                } else {
                    return Err(ScrapeError::Http(e));
                }
            }
        }

        let base_delay = 2u64.pow(attempt);
        let jitter = rand::thread_rng().gen_range(0..base_delay);
        let delay = Duration::from_secs(base_delay + jitter);

        tracing::warn!(
            url = url,
            attempt = attempt + 1,
            max_retries = max_retries,
            delay_ms = delay.as_millis() as u64,
            "Retrying request"
        );
        tokio::time::sleep(delay).await;
    }

    last_error.ok_or_else(|| ScrapeError::Parse("max retries exceeded".into()))
}
```

# Chapter: EPUB Generation Advanced Topics

## Chapter Content Formatting

### Cleaning HTML Content

```rust
fn clean_chapter_html(html: &str) -> String {
    let mut clean = html.to_string();

    // Remove script and style tags
    let script_re = regex::Regex::new(r"<script[^>]*>.*?</script>").unwrap();
    let style_re = regex::Regex::new(r"<style[^>]*>.*?</style>").unwrap();
    clean = script_re.replace_all(&clean, "").to_string();
    clean = style_re.replace_all(&clean, "").to_string();

    // Remove comments
    let comment_re = regex::Regex::new(r"<!--.*?-->").unwrap();
    clean = comment_re.replace_all(&clean, "").to_string();

    // Fix common issues
    let br_re = regex::Regex::new(r"<br\s*/?>").unwrap();
    clean = br_re.replace_all(&clean, "<br/>").to_string();

    let empty_p_re = regex::Regex::new(r"<p>\s*</p>").unwrap();
    clean = empty_p_re.replace_all(&clean, "").to_string();

    let space_re = regex::Regex::new(r"\s+").unwrap();
    clean = space_re.replace_all(&clean, " ").to_string();

    clean.trim().to_string()
```
```rust
}
```

### Custom Metadata

```rust
fn set_epub_metadata(
    builder: &mut EpubBuilder<ZipLibrary>,
    metadata: &FicMetadata,
) -> Result<(), ExportError> {
    builder.set_metadata("title", &metadata.title)?;
    builder.set_metadata("creator", &metadata.author)?;
    builder.set_metadata("language", "en")?;
    builder.set_metadata("publisher", "FicHub")?;

    if !metadata.summary.is_empty() {
        builder.set_metadata("description", &metadata.summary)?;
    }

    builder.set_metadata("rights", &format!(
        "Fanfiction by {}. Original work belongs to the respective authors.",
        metadata.author
    ))?;

    builder.set_metadata("identifier", &format!("urn:fichub:{}", metadata.url_id))?;

    let now = chrono::Utc::now().format("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ");
    builder.set_metadata("date", &now.to_string())?;

    builder.set_metadata("source", &metadata.url)?;
    builder.set_metadata("fichub:words", &metadata.words.to_string())?;
    builder.set_metadata("fichub:chapters", &metadata.chapters.to_string())?;
    builder.set_metadata("fichub:complete", &metadata.complete.to_string())?;
    builder.set_metadata("fichub:source", &metadata.source)?;

    Ok(())
}
```

# Chapter: Docker Deep Dive

## Multi-Stage Builds

FicHub uses multi-stage Docker builds to create small, efficient images:

```dockerfile
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1

# Stage 1: Build the Rust binary
FROM rust:1.77-slim as builder

RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y     pkg-config     libssl-dev     && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

WORKDIR /app

COPY Cargo.toml Cargo.lock ./
RUN mkdir src && echo "fn main() {}" > src/main.rs
RUN cargo build --release
RUN rm -rf src

COPY src ./src
RUN cargo build --release

# Stage 2: Create the slim runtime image
FROM debian:bookworm-slim

RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y     ca-certificates     libssl3     curl     && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

RUN useradd --create-home --shell /bin/bash fichub

WORKDIR /home/fichub

COPY --from=builder /app/target/release/fichub-rs ./fichub-rs
COPY migrations ./migrations
COPY frontend/build ./frontend/build
COPY .env.example .env

RUN chown -R fichub:fichub /home/fichub

USER fichub

EXPOSE 3000

HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=10s --start-period=40s --retries=3     CMD curl -f http://localhost:3000/api/v0/health || exit 1

CMD ["./fichub-rs"]
```

**Why multi-stage?**
- Builder stage: ~2GB (Rust toolchain + build deps)
- Runtime stage: ~100MB (binary + runtime deps)
- Result: 95% smaller image!

```rust
pub async fn metrics_handler() -> Response {
    let encoder = TextEncoder::new();
    let metric_families = prometheus::gather();
    let mut buffer = Vec::new();
    encoder.encode(&metric_families, &mut buffer).unwrap();

    Response::builder()
        .status(200)
        .header("Content-Type", encoder.format_type())
        .body(buffer.into())
        .unwrap()
}
```

# Chapter: Backup and Recovery

## Automated Backups

```bash
#!/bin/bash
# backup.sh — Daily backup script

set -e

BACKUP_DIR="/var/backups/fichub"
DATE=$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)
RETENTION_DAYS=30

mkdir -p "$BACKUP_DIR"

# Backup PostgreSQL
echo "Backing up PostgreSQL..."
pg_dump -U fichub fichub | gzip > "$BACKUP_DIR/db_$DATE.sql.gz"

# Backup Redis
echo "Backing up Redis..."
redis-cli BGSAVE
sleep 5
cp /var/lib/redis/dump.rdb "$BACKUP_DIR/redis_$DATE.rdb"

# Backup configuration
echo "Backing up configuration..."
tar czf "$BACKUP_DIR/config_$DATE.tar.gz"     /home/fichub/.env     /home/fichub/nginx.conf

# Clean up old backups
echo "Cleaning up old backups..."
find "$BACKUP_DIR" -name "*.gz" -mtime +$RETENTION_DAYS -delete
find "$BACKUP_DIR" -name "*.rdb" -mtime +$RETENTION_DAYS -delete

echo "Backup complete: $DATE"
```

# Chapter: Security Hardening

## Input Validation

```rust
fn validate_url(url: &str) -> Result<String, AppError> {
    if !url.starts_with("http://") && !url.starts_with("https://") {
        return Err(AppError::BadRequest(-5, "URL must start with http:// or https://".into()));
    }

    let parsed = url::Url::parse(url)
        .map_err(|_| AppError::BadRequest(-5, "Invalid URL format".into()))?;

    let host = parsed.host_str()
        .ok_or_else(|| AppError::BadRequest(-5, "URL must have a host".into()))?;

    let supported = [
        "archiveofourown.org",
        "fanfiction.net",
        "fictionpress.com",
        "forums.spacebattles.com",
        "forums.sufficientvelocity.com",
    ];

    if !supported.iter().any(|&domain| host.ends_with(domain)) {
        return Err(AppError::BadRequest(-5, "Unsupported site".into()));
    }

    if url.len() > 2000 {
        return Err(AppError::BadRequest(-5, "URL too long".into()));
    }

    Ok(url.to_string())
}
```

## Security Headers

```rust
async fn security_headers(
    request: Request,
    next: Next,
) -> Response {
    let mut response = next.run(request).await;

    let headers = response.headers_mut();

    headers.insert("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff".parse().unwrap());
    headers.insert("X-Frame-Options", "DENY".parse().unwrap());
    headers.insert("X-XSS-Protection", "1; mode=block".parse().unwrap());
    headers.insert(
        "Strict-Transport-Security",
        "max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains".parse().unwrap(),
    );
    headers.insert(
        "Content-Security-Policy",
        "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'".parse().unwrap(),
    );

    response
}
```

## Security Checklist

- [ ] All database queries use parameterized queries
- [ ] User input is validated before processing
- [ ] CORS is configured correctly for production
- [ ] Rate limiting is enabled on all endpoints
- [ ] Secrets are stored in environment variables, not code
- [ ] Security headers are set on all responses
- [ ] HTTPS is enforced in production
- [ ] Dependencies are audited regularly
- [ ] Error messages don't leak internal details
- [ ] Database backups are encrypted
- [ ] Logs don't contain sensitive data
- [ ] File uploads are validated and sandboxed
- [ ] SQL injection prevention is verified
- [ ] XSS prevention is verified
- [ ] CSRF protection is enabled where needed
